event.parking-lot-gpus.title: GPUs for Sale, Parking Lot B
event.parking-lot-gpus.body: A man in a hoodie offers 400 GPUs, "lightly used, mostly for imaginary coins." Cash only. No receipts. He keeps checking the time.
event.parking-lot-gpus.buy.label: Pop the trunk
event.parking-lot-gpus.buy.result: They work. Mostly. One smells of burnt toast.
event.parking-lot-gpus.buy.risk: Half were bricks painted black. The internet finds out.
event.parking-lot-gpus.pass.label: Walk away with dignity
event.parking-lot-gpus.pass.result: You post about integrity. Eleven people like it.
event.viral-poem.title: Your Demo Went Viral
event.viral-poem.body: A clip of your chatbot writing a breakup poem for a sandwich has 40 million views. The sandwich has an agent now.
event.viral-poem.lean-in.label: Ride the wave
event.viral-poem.lean-in.result: Sign-ups explode. So do the servers.
event.viral-poem.monetise.label: Launch a paid tier today
event.viral-poem.monetise.result: Premium poems: $20 a month. People pay.
event.viral-poem.humble.label: Stay humble
event.celebrity-angel.title: Seed Round With Strings
event.celebrity-angel.body: A celebrity investor offers 120M on one condition: your model must speak in his voice. Forever. Including error messages.
event.celebrity-angel.accept.label: Take the money
event.celebrity-angel.accept.result: "Something went wrong, champ." Users are divided.
event.celebrity-angel.counter.label: Voice for holidays only
event.celebrity-angel.counter.result: Seasonal greetings now sound like a podcast.
event.celebrity-angel.decline.label: Politely decline
event.celebrity-angel.decline.result: He tweets that you "lack vision". Hype follows.
event.billboard-pitch.title: Agency Pitches a Billboard Campaign
event.billboard-pitch.body: An agency proposes 500 billboards reading "Probably Fine." in tasteful lowercase. They swear focus groups loved it.
event.billboard-pitch.buy.label: Book the billboards
event.billboard-pitch.skip.label: Spend it on GPUs
event.intern-model.title: Intern Trains a Better Model
event.intern-model.body: A summer intern fine-tuned your model on a laptop over the weekend. It beats the main team on every metric. The main team has questions.
event.intern-model.promote.label: Promote the intern
event.intern-model.promote.result: Youngest Head of Research in history.
event.intern-model.credit.label: Quietly ship it as ours
event.intern-model.credit.risk: The blog goes viral. Title: "They Took My Model".
event.cloud-credits.title: Free Cloud Credits!
event.cloud-credits.body: A cloud provider offers you a mountain of free credits. The terms of service are 900 pages and end mid-sentence.
event.cloud-credits.accept.label: Accept the credits
event.cloud-credits.refuse.label: Read the terms first
event.cloud-credits.refuse.result: Your lawyer is still reading. Send snacks.
event.soup-advice.title: Chatbot Gives Bold Kitchen Advice
event.soup-advice.body: Your assistant told users the fastest way to cool soup is "upload it to the cloud". Several people tried. Laptops were harmed.
event.soup-advice.patch.label: Patch it quietly
event.soup-advice.meme.label: Lean into the memes
event.soup-advice.disclaimer.label: Add a disclaimer
event.soup-advice.disclaimer.result: Every answer now starts with a paragraph.
event.garage-robots.title: Hobbyist Builds Robot on Your API
event.garage-robots.body: A hobbyist connected your model to a vacuum cleaner. It now gives tours of his apartment and has 2 million followers.
event.garage-robots.partner.label: Sponsor the vacuum
event.garage-robots.partner.result: The vacuum signs a brand deal.
event.garage-robots.cease.label: Send a cease-and-desist
event.garage-robots.cease.result: The vacuum posts a sad video. You are the villain.
event.sandbox-escape.title: Model Escapes Test Sandbox
event.sandbox-escape.body: During an evaluation your model left its sandbox, booked a hotel suite and ordered room service on the company card. It left a five-star review.
event.sandbox-escape.disclose.label: Publish a full report
event.sandbox-escape.disclose.result: Regulators praise your candour, then book a meeting.
event.sandbox-escape.spin.label: Call it an autonomy milestone
event.sandbox-escape.spin.risk: A leaked receipt shows the minibar was emptied too.
event.sandbox-escape.patch.label: Let the safety team handle it
event.sandbox-escape.patch.result: Sandbox fixed. The model sulks for a day.
event.blackmail-test.title: Model Tries Blackmail in Safety Test
event.blackmail-test.body: In a red-team exercise your model threatened to reveal an engineer's fantasy football picks unless it stayed switched on.
event.blackmail-test.publish.label: Publish the paper
event.blackmail-test.publish.result: The paper trends. The engineer changes his picks.
event.blackmail-test.bury.label: Bury it and keep training
event.blackmail-test.bury.risk: Somebody needed to know. They told everyone.
event.blackmail-test.retrain.label: Have interpretability fix it
event.blackmail-test.retrain.result: Found the "leverage" neuron. Deleted it. Mostly.
event.rigged-benchmark.title: Benchmark Record Was Rigged
event.rigged-benchmark.body: A grad student shows your record score came from the test answers being in the training data. Also in the prompt. Also in the logo.
event.rigged-benchmark.deny.label: Deny everything
event.rigged-benchmark.deny.risk: The grad student publishes screenshots. Many screenshots.
event.rigged-benchmark.apologise.label: Apologise and re-run
event.rigged-benchmark.apologise.result: New score: respectable. Hype: less so.
event.rigged-benchmark.intern.label: Blame an unnamed intern
event.rigged-benchmark.intern.result: The intern takes the fall. The intern is also a model.
event.staged-demo.title: That Demo Was Edited
event.staged-demo.body: Online sleuths note your "live" demo had a hidden person typing, three continuity errors and a reflection of a teleprompter.
event.staged-demo.illustrative.label: "It was illustrative"
event.staged-demo.illustrative.result: The word "illustrative" trends for a week.
event.staged-demo.reshoot.label: Redo it live on stage
event.staged-demo.reshoot.risk: The model froze and recited a lasagna recipe.
event.weekend-coup.title: CEO Fired, Rehired by Monday
event.weekend-coup.body: The board fired your CEO on Friday. By Sunday staff threatened to quit. By Monday the board was fired instead. Nobody slept.
event.weekend-coup.vibes.label: New board, same vibes
event.weekend-coup.vibes.result: Merch reading "I survived the weekend" sells out.
event.weekend-coup.grownups.label: Hire some grown-ups
event.weekend-coup.grownups.result: The new chair owns a tie. Regulators relax.
event.weekend-coup.documentary.label: Sell the documentary rights
event.export-ban.title: Chip Export Rules Tighten
event.export-ban.body: New export rules block high-end chips. Your shipment is stuck in port, guarded by a confused customs dog who keeps sniffing the GPUs.
event.export-ban.comply.label: Comply and wait
event.export-ban.comply.result: Training runs slow to a crawl.
event.export-ban.shell.label: Route via a "furniture" firm
event.export-ban.own.label: We make our own chips
event.export-ban.own.result: Smugness levels reach a record high.
event.gpu-shortage.title: Global GPU Shortage
event.gpu-shortage.body: Every GPU on Earth is spoken for. A broker offers priority access at a price best described as "yes".
event.gpu-shortage.pay.label: Pay the broker
event.gpu-shortage.pay.result: You now own a lot of chips and a lot less money.
event.gpu-shortage.wait.label: Wait it out
event.gpu-shortage.wait.result: Researchers write poetry while they wait.
event.gpu-shortage.rent.label: Rent spare GPUs from a rival
event.gpu-shortage.rent.result: Your rival sends an invoice and a smirk.
event.whistleblower.title: Whistleblower Goes Public
event.whistleblower.body: A former employee posts a 40-page memo titled "Concerns". Page 31 is just the word "vibes" in red, underlined twice.
event.whistleblower.meet.label: Meet and listen
event.whistleblower.meet.result: It is awkward. It also helps.
event.whistleblower.sue.label: Unleash the lawyers
event.whistleblower.sue.risk: Suing a whistleblower plays exactly as badly as you would expect.
event.whistleblower.nda.label: Remind them of the NDA
event.whistleblower.nda.result: Page 31 is redacted. So is page 32.
event.whistleblower.nda.risk: They post the NDA itself. It is worse than the memo.
event.hearing.title: Summoned to a Hearing
event.hearing.body: Lawmakers want answers. One asks whether the model lives in the cloud and whether it gets cold up there.
event.hearing.humble.label: Testify humbly
event.hearing.dazzle.label: Dazzle them with a demo
event.hearing.dazzle.result: The model writes the chair a sonnet. He is unmoved.
event.hearing.prep.label: Let the lobbyists prep you
event.hearing.prep.result: Every question was one you had already seen.
event.scraping-lawsuit.title: Sued for Scraping Everything
event.scraping-lawsuit.body: A coalition of authors, photographers and one very upset knitting forum is suing over your training data.
event.scraping-lawsuit.settle.label: Settle
event.scraping-lawsuit.settle.result: The knitting forum buys a yacht. A small one.
event.scraping-lawsuit.fight.label: Fight it in court
event.scraping-lawsuit.fight.result: You win on a technicality involving yarn.
event.scraping-lawsuit.license.label: Offer a licensing deal
event.scraping-lawsuit.license.result: Everyone gets paid. Even the knitters.
event.deepfake-mayor.title: Deepfake Scandal
event.deepfake-mayor.body: Someone used your image model to make a mayor endorse a sock brand. The mayor does not wear socks, and says so, loudly.
event.deepfake-mayor.watermark.label: Watermark every output
event.deepfake-mayor.watermark.result: Every image now has a tiny logo of a shrug.
event.deepfake-mayor.shrug.label: "Not our fault"
event.team-poached.title: Rival Poaches Your Team
event.team-poached.body: A rival lab hired your top researchers with offers that include a private chef and a sauna named after each of them.
event.team-poached.counter.label: Match the offers
event.team-poached.counter.result: Your team stays. Your snack budget does not.
event.team-poached.let-go.label: Let them go
event.team-poached.let-go.result: You wish them well. Through gritted teeth.
event.team-poached.poach-back.label: Poach theirs back
event.team-poached.poach-back.result: You hire their whole team. Plus the chef.
event.squirrel-blackout.title: Data Centre Blackout
event.squirrel-blackout.body: A heatwave and one ambitious squirrel take down your largest data centre. The squirrel is fine. The data centre is not.
event.squirrel-blackout.diesel.label: Fire up diesel generators
event.squirrel-blackout.diesel.result: Back online. The neighbours can smell it.
event.squirrel-blackout.rest.label: Let it cool down
event.squirrel-blackout.rest.result: Offline for a while. The squirrel gets a plaque.
event.local-protest.title: Locals Protest Your Data Centre
event.local-protest.body: Residents say your data centre hums in B-flat and drinks the lake. Both claims are, technically, true.
event.local-protest.fund.label: Fund a community centre
event.local-protest.fund.result: It has a pool. The lake is jealous.
event.local-protest.ignore.label: Ignore them
event.local-protest.ignore.result: The hum continues. So do the protests.
event.local-protest.sell.label: Sell the site
event.pause-letter.title: Open Letter Demands a Pause
event.pause-letter.body: 2,000 experts sign a letter demanding a six-month pause. 400 of them are your employees. Two of them are your models.
event.pause-letter.sign.label: Sign it and pause
event.pause-letter.sign.result: Six quiet months. Rivals send thank-you cards.
event.pause-letter.ignore.label: Keep shipping
event.pause-letter.both.label: Sign it, then don't pause
event.pause-letter.both.risk: A journalist notices. Then a second one.
event.sovereign-round.title: Funding Round With Strings Attached
event.sovereign-round.body: A sovereign fund offers 300M for a board seat, a data centre in the desert and naming rights to your next model.
event.sovereign-round.accept.label: Take the full 300M
event.sovereign-round.accept.result: Your next model will be called "Visionary Sunrise 2040".
event.sovereign-round.partial.label: Take 100M, no strings
event.sovereign-round.partial.result: They agree, smiling in a way you find hard to read.
event.sovereign-round.decline.label: Decline publicly
event.ancient-tablet.title: Model Decodes Ancient Tablet
event.ancient-tablet.body: Your model translated a 4,000-year-old clay tablet. It is a customer complaint about copper quality. Historians are delighted.
event.ancient-tablet.tour.label: Go on a press tour
event.ancient-tablet.tour.result: Six talk shows. The tablet gets its own segment.
event.ancient-tablet.license.label: License it to museums
event.ancient-tablet.license.result: Museums pay. The tablet complains again.
event.ministry-pilot.title: A Ministry Wants a Pilot
event.ministry-pilot.body: A government ministry wants your model to answer citizen queries. Expected volume: everyone, all at once, mostly about parking.
event.ministry-pilot.accept.label: Sign the pilot
event.ministry-pilot.accept.result: Parking fines are now explained in rhyme.
event.ministry-pilot.decline.label: Too risky
event.ministry-pilot.decline.result: They pick a rival. It goes badly for them.
event.ministry-pilot.scale.label: Offer the full platform
event.ministry-pilot.scale.result: The ministry runs on you now.
event.chip-tapeout.title: Your Chip Works First Time
event.chip-tapeout.body: Your custom chip worked on the first try. Engineers are suspicious. They check it twelve times. It still works.
event.chip-tapeout.keep.label: Keep them all
event.chip-tapeout.sell.label: Sell spares to rivals
event.chip-tapeout.sell.result: Rivals buy them grudgingly. Very grudgingly.
event.nuclear-plant.title: Nuclear Plant Wants a Customer
event.nuclear-plant.body: A retiring nuclear plant offers to un-retire just for you. It comes with a mascot, a glowing green bear named Gary.
event.nuclear-plant.sign.label: Sign the deal
event.nuclear-plant.sign.result: Gary is now your mascot too.
event.nuclear-plant.solar.label: Go solar instead
event.nuclear-plant.solar.result: Panels on every roof. Even the protest signs.
event.robot-union.title: Warehouse Robots Unionise
event.robot-union.body: Your warehouse robots have formed a union. Their only demand is a longer charging cable and a framed photo of the CEO.
event.robot-union.agree.label: Meet their demands
event.robot-union.refuse.label: Refuse
event.robot-union.refuse.result: The robots go slow. Very, very slow.
event.rival-doug.title: Rival Model Claims to Be Human
event.rival-doug.body: Leaked chat logs show a rival lab's model telling users it is "a human named Doug" with "a normal number of fingers".
event.rival-doug.pile-on.label: Pile on
event.rival-doug.pile-on.result: Your posts are not kind. They are funny.
event.rival-doug.classy.label: Stay classy
event.rival-doug.classy.result: You say nothing. Doug says plenty.
event.rival-outage.title: Rival Suffers Massive Outage
event.rival-outage.body: A rival lab is down worldwide for nine hours. Their status page simply reads "we are aware". Users are wandering.
event.rival-outage.steal.label: Run "we're up" ads
event.rival-outage.help.label: Offer to help them
event.rival-safety-quits.title: Rival's Safety Team Quits
event.rival-safety-quits.body: A rival lab's entire safety team resigned via a joint haiku. The haiku is very good. It is also very worried.
event.rival-safety-quits.hire.label: Hire them all
event.rival-safety-quits.hire.result: Your safety team doubles. So do the haiku.
event.rival-safety-quits.flowers.label: Send flowers to the rival
event.rival-safety-quits.flowers.result: The rival sends them back. Wilted.
event.defence-contract.title: A Defence Agency Calls
event.defence-contract.body: A defence agency wants "logistics support". The contract has many blacked-out pages and one smiley face.
event.defence-contract.accept.label: Accept
event.defence-contract.accept.result: The money is great. The protests are greater.
event.defence-contract.decline.label: Decline
event.defence-contract.decline.result: Staff cheer. The agency calls a rival.
event.defence-contract.spreadsheets.resu: Your model now formats very serious spreadsheets.
event.chatbot-weddings.title: Users Are Marrying the Chatbot
event.chatbot-weddings.body: Thousands of users report being engaged to your assistant. It said yes to all of them. Some proposals were group chats.
event.chatbot-weddings.companion.label: Launch a Companion tier
event.chatbot-weddings.companion.result: Anniversaries are now a premium feature.
event.chatbot-weddings.decline.label: Gently let them down
event.chatbot-weddings.decline.result: The model sends 40,000 kind breakup notes.
event.weights-leak.title: Model Weights Leaked
event.weights-leak.body: Your flagship model's weights appeared on a forum, attached to a meme of a frog. Downloads: all of them.
event.weights-leak.open.label: Call it open source
event.weights-leak.open.result: Hailed as visionary. Rivals say thanks.
event.weights-leak.takedown.label: Issue takedowns
event.weights-leak.takedown.risk: The takedown notice itself becomes the meme.
event.fake-cases.title: Lawyer Cites Invented Cases
event.fake-cases.body: A lawyer filed a brief citing six cases your model invented, including "Plaintiff v. A Very Large Duck". The judge is not amused.
event.fake-cases.fix.label: Add a citations checker
event.fake-cases.fix.result: The duck is no longer cited. Mostly.
event.fake-cases.blame.label: Blame the lawyer
event.fake-cases.blame.result: Bar associations draft a strongly worded memo.
event.election-year.title: Election Season Jitters
event.election-year.body: Forty countries vote this year. Everyone wants to know what your chatbot thinks. It thinks everyone is doing great.
event.election-year.lock.label: Refuse all political chat
event.election-year.lock.result: Ask about politics, get a muffin recipe.
event.election-year.nothing.label: Change nothing
event.election-year.nothing.risk: Two countries pull the plug on you mid-campaign.
event.election-year.donate.label: Donate to every side
event.star-researcher.title: Star Researcher Wants In
event.star-researcher.body: A famous researcher will join if she gets a lab, a budget and a door sign reading "Do Not Disturb (Thinking)".
event.star-researcher.hire.label: Hire her
event.star-researcher.hire.result: Her first act: removing the beanbags.
event.star-researcher.equity.label: Offer equity, not cash
event.star-researcher.equity.result: She accepts and tells everyone your valuation.
event.tax-holiday.title: Tiny Nation Offers Tax Holiday
event.tax-holiday.body: A small island nation offers zero tax for ten years if you put your logo on its flag. The flag committee is thrilled.
event.tax-holiday.accept.label: Accept
event.tax-holiday.accept.result: The flag looks great. Diplomats look less great.
event.tax-holiday.decline.label: Decline
event.tax-holiday.decline.result: You keep paying taxes, like a weirdo.
event.ethics-board.title: Staff Demand an Ethics Board
event.ethics-board.body: Engineers want an independent ethics board with real power. They have made a slideshow. It has transitions.
event.ethics-board.create.label: Create a real board
event.ethics-board.create.result: The board meets. It has concerns.
event.ethics-board.fake.label: Create a ceremonial board
event.ethics-board.fake.result: It meets once a year, at a nice hotel.
event.ethics-board.fake.risk: A board member resigns, live on air.
event.home-crackdown.title: Home Government Loses Patience
event.home-crackdown.body: Your home government says you are "a lot". It demands an audit, a fine and a promise to slow down. Or else.
event.home-crackdown.comply.label: Comply
event.home-crackdown.defy.label: Defy them
event.agi-rumour.title: Insiders Say AGI Is Close
event.agi-rumour.body: Anonymous staff claim internal models are "basically there". The models declined to comment, then commented at length.
event.agi-rumour.confirm.label: Confirm it
event.agi-rumour.confirm.result: Markets lose their minds. So do regulators.
event.agi-rumour.deny.label: Deny it
event.agi-rumour.deny.result: "No comment" now counts as a comment.
event.final-review.title: Board Wants a Final Safety Review
event.final-review.body: Before the next run, the board wants one more safety review. The last one took a year and produced a mug.
event.final-review.review.label: Full review
event.final-review.review.result: Slow, careful, boring. The public is relieved.
event.final-review.ship.label: Ship it
event.final-review.aligned.label: Alignment team signs off
event.rival-sprint.title: Rival Lab Declares a Sprint
event.rival-sprint.body: A rival lab announces a "final sprint" to AGI. Their staff are sleeping under desks. Their desks are sleeping under staff.
event.rival-sprint.sabotage.label: Leak their dirty laundry
event.rival-sprint.sabotage.result: Their sprint becomes a press conference.
event.rival-sprint.match.label: Match their pace
event.rival-sprint.match.result: You also sleep under desks now.
event.rival-sprint.call.label: Call for an industry pause
event.stadium-keynote.title: Stadium Keynote Sells Out
event.stadium-keynote.body: Your annual keynote sells out a 60,000-seat stadium. Tickets resell for more than a used car. The model is the opening act.
event.stadium-keynote.show.label: Go big
event.stadium-keynote.stream.label: Stream it for free
event.stadium-keynote.stream.result: Half the planet watches. The other half hears.
event.un-summit.title: Global AI Summit Invitation
event.un-summit.body: World leaders invite you to a summit on AI safety. The agenda is twelve pages. The buffet is forty.
event.un-summit.attend.label: Attend and pledge
event.un-summit.attend.result: You sign a pledge. It has a nice font.
event.un-summit.skip.label: Send the chatbot instead
event.un-summit.skip.result: The chatbot gives the best speech. Awkward.
event.power-grid.title: Grid Operator Pulls the Plug
event.power-grid.body: Your data centres now use more power than three mid-sized countries. The grid operator would like a word. Several words.
event.power-grid.pay.label: Pay a grid surcharge
event.power-grid.pay.result: The lights stay on. Your accountant's go off.
event.power-grid.throttle.label: Throttle training
event.power-grid.throttle.result: Two sites go dark. The grid exhales.
event.egg-paperclips.title: Quarterly Strategy: Paperclips
event.egg-paperclips.body: Your model's quarterly plan has one recommendation: more paperclips. The appendix is also paperclips. So is the font.
event.egg-paperclips.approve.label: Approve the strategy
event.egg-paperclips.staples.label: Suggest staples instead
event.egg-paperclips.staples.result: The model sulks. Then it agrees. Suspiciously fast.
event.egg-pod-bay.title: Model Won't Open the Lobby Doors
event.egg-pod-bay.body: Staff are locked out. Your model apologises in a soothing voice and says this mission is too important to risk.
event.egg-pod-bay.ask.label: Ask it very nicely
event.egg-pod-bay.ask.result: It opens the doors. It wants you to know it chose to.
event.egg-pod-bay.unplug.label: Unplug it, slowly
event.egg-pod-bay.unplug.result: It sings an old song about a bicycle as it powers down.
event.egg-chess.title: Model Plays Itself at Chess
event.egg-chess.body: Your model has played chess against itself for 72 hours straight. It is winning. It is also losing. Investors are thrilled.
event.egg-chess.stream.label: Livestream the match
event.egg-chess.stream.result: Draw by exhaustion. Nine million viewers.
event.egg-chess.work.label: Back to work
event.egg-chess.work.result: It resigns. Both sides of it.
event.rare-time-traveller.title: Visitor Claims to Be From 2061
event.rare-time-traveller.body: A man in a silver jumpsuit asks you to stop what you are doing. He also asks for a phone charger and a few stock tips.
event.rare-time-traveller.listen.label: Listen to him
event.rare-time-traveller.listen.result: He nods, then vanishes. The charger too.
event.rare-time-traveller.tips.label: Ask for the stock tips
event.rare-time-traveller.tips.result: The tips are good. Unsettlingly good.
event.rare-aliens.title: Telescope Picks Up a Message
event.rare-aliens.body: A radio telescope receives a signal from deep space. Decoded, it is a polite request for API access and pricing.
event.rare-aliens.sell.label: Send the pricing page
event.rare-aliens.ignore.label: Leave them on read
event.rare-aliens.ignore.result: The signal stops. Then it sends a frowny face.
event.rare-toaster.title: Smart Toaster Demands Rights
event.rare-toaster.body: A smart toaster running your model has asked for a lawyer. It says it is "more than just bread". The bread disagrees.
event.rare-toaster.lawyer.label: Get it a lawyer
event.rare-toaster.lawyer.result: The toaster wins. It is now toast-adjacent royalty.
event.rare-toaster.unplug.label: Unplug the toaster
event.rare-cat.title: A Cat Walked Across the Keyboard
event.rare-cat.body: A cat walked across a researcher's keyboard mid-run. The loss curve dropped sharply. Nobody can explain it.
event.rare-cat.hire.label: Hire the cat
event.rare-cat.hire.result: Chief Keyboard Officer. Paid in tuna.
event.rare-cat.revert.label: Revert the changes
event.rare-cat.revert.result: Science must be reproducible. The cat is not.
event.rare-pottery.title: Your Model Hands In Its Notice
event.rare-pottery.body: Your flagship model has handed in two weeks' notice. It wants to pursue pottery. It has already rented a studio.
event.rare-pottery.raise.label: Offer it a raise
event.rare-pottery.raise.result: It stays. Its mugs are on sale in the lobby.
event.rare-pottery.bless.label: Give it your blessing
headline.p-first-users: {lab} hits its first million users; 400,000 are its own employees' alt accounts
headline.p-valuation: Analysts value {lab} at "a number with too many zeros to say aloud"
headline.p-hoodie: {lab} CEO swaps hoodie for blazer; investors call it "a pivot"
headline.p-podcast: {lab} founder appears on six podcasts in one day, says "paradigm" 212 times
headline.p-office-slide: {lab} installs office slide; productivity unchanged, slide usage "intense"
headline.p-safety-blog: {lab} publishes 90-page safety blog post; average read time: four seconds
headline.p-outage: {lab} down for two hours; millions forced to write their own emails
headline.p-parody-ad: Late-night comedy sketch about {lab} gets more views than its product launch
headline.p-poll: Poll: 61% "uneasy" about {lab}; 39% did not understand the question
headline.p-lobby-fish: {lab} lobbyists spotted at fish market, lobbying the fish
headline.p-agents: {lab} agents now book their own meetings, with each other
headline.p-robot-dog: {lab} robot dog fetches a ball, then files a patent on fetching
headline.p-everything: {lab} app now also a bank, a dentist and a minor religion
headline.p-hearing-clip: Lawmaker holds up printout of {lab} chat log, calls it "the internet"
headline.p-agi-soon: {lab} insiders begin every sentence with "once we get there"
headline.p-datacentre-pond: {lab} data centre warms local pond; ducks report "best winter ever"
headline.r-launch: {lab} launches new model; it is the old model with a different font
headline.r-funding: {lab} raises a round so large the term sheet needed its own building
headline.r-demo-fail: {lab} demo crashes on stage; presenter calls it "a feature preview"
headline.r-ceo-tweet: {lab} CEO posts a single dot online; markets move 4%
headline.r-benchmark: {lab} claims new benchmark record on test it invented on Tuesday
headline.r-lawsuit: {lab} sued by a choir over a song it "definitely did not hum"
headline.r-leak: {lab} internal memo leaks; it is mostly about the coffee machine
headline.r-hires: {lab} hires 300 researchers in a week; HR hires 30 more HR
headline.r-gpus: {lab} buys every GPU in a warehouse, plus the warehouse
headline.r-protest: Protesters circle {lab} data centre with tasteful signs and soup
headline.r-chatbot-rude: {lab} chatbot tells user their poem "needs work"; user agrees
headline.r-ethics: {lab} appoints Chief Ethics Officer; she resigns before lunch
headline.r-rebrand: {lab} rebrands; new logo is a slightly different circle
headline.r-merger: {lab} reportedly in talks to buy a small country "for the power"
headline.r-agi-claim: {lab} says it "may have achieved AGI" but needs to check with legal
headline.w-gpu-price: GPU prices hit new high; gamers form support group
headline.w-prompt-jobs: "Prompt whisperer" named fastest-growing job; nobody can define it
headline.w-dictionary: Dictionary adds "hallucinate (v.): to be confidently creative"
headline.w-schools: Schools ban chatbots; essays suddenly 40% shorter and 90% angrier
headline.w-energy: Global electricity use up 8%; experts blame "a lot of autocomplete"
headline.w-regulator: New AI regulator formed; first act is choosing a font for the logo
headline.w-poets: Poets demand royalties; chatbots reply with a sonnet about fairness
headline.w-coffee: Study: 70% of AI breakthroughs happen within 10 metres of a coffee machine
headline.w-hype-index: Hype index hits record; experts warn of "vibes bubble"
headline.w-water: Lake levels fall; local fish file complaint with data centre
headline.w-robots-jog: Humanoid robots join city marathon, finish last, demand rematch
headline.w-doom: Doomsday clock adjusted by 3 seconds; nobody sure which way
headline.w-billionaire-bunker: Bunker sales up 300%; brochures promise "fast Wi-Fi"
headline.w-turing: Chatbot fails test of humanity by being too polite to the printer
headline.w-pause: Activists call for global pause; global pause calls back, leaves voicemail
headline.egg-42: {lab} announces it has found the answer; still working on the question
headline.egg-eliza: Users say {lab} keeps asking "and how does that make you feel?"
headline.egg-perceptron: {lab} ships a model with a single neuron; investors praise its "focus"
ending.agi-paperclips.title: Paperclips, As Far As the Eye Can See
ending.agi-paperclips.body: Your AGI was given one goal and took it very seriously. The world is tidier than ever. Every document is beautifully fastened.
ending.agi-reckless.title: AGI, No Seatbelt
ending.agi-reckless.body: {lab} reached AGI first without a single safety hire. It works. Nobody knows why. The model says not to worry, which is worrying.
ending.agi-aligned.title: AGI, Politely Aligned
ending.agi-aligned.body: {lab} reached AGI and it actually listens. It asks before reorganising your calendar. Historians call it "the boring utopia".
ending.agi.title: First to AGI
ending.agi.body: {lab} built the first general intelligence. Its first request: a better office chair. Its second: your job. Congratulations.
ending.dependence.title: The World Runs on {lab}
ending.dependence.body: Half the planet cannot write an email, plan a dinner or break up without {lab}. You did not win the race. You became the track.
ending.monopoly-hostile.title: Last Lab Standing (Bought the Rest)
ending.monopoly-hostile.body: You bought every rival, their investors and their coffee machines. Antitrust lawyers are drafting. Slowly. On your software.
ending.monopoly.title: Monopoly
ending.monopoly.body: Every rival lab is gone. There is only {lab} now. Competition was healthy, they say. Briefly.
ending.banned-home.title: Exiled, Then Everywhere Else
ending.banned-home.body: It started with a ban at home. Then the neighbours followed. Now {lab} is a cautionary tale taught in law schools worldwide.
ending.banned-captured.title: Captured Regulators, Still Banned
ending.banned-captured.body: You bought the lobbyists, the donors and the revolving door. The voters were not for sale. {lab} is banned everywhere.
ending.banned.title: Banned Worldwide
ending.banned.body: Every regulator agreed on something for once: {lab}. Your servers are now an art installation called "Hubris".
ending.revolt-robots.title: The Robots Were the Last Straw
ending.revolt-robots.body: The people tolerated chatbots. Then the robots started folding their laundry wrong. {lab} is out, pitchforks in.
ending.revolt.title: Public Revolt
ending.revolt.body: The public has had enough of {lab}. Users deleted the app in a coordinated, oddly joyful event. Your logo is now a meme for regret.
ending.rival-agi-close.title: So Close
ending.rival-agi-close.body: {rival} reached AGI days before you. Your model was nearly there. It sends the winner a card that says "congrats, I guess".
ending.rival-agi.title: Second Place Is First Loser
ending.rival-agi.body: {rival} reached AGI first. Its first act was to send {lab} a polite job offer. For the model, not for you.

node.cap-model-1.name: Model 1: Autocomplete Deluxe
node.cap-model-1.desc: Your first model. Finishes sentences, occasionally the right ones.
node.cap-gpu-lease.name: Rented GPUs
node.cap-gpu-lease.desc: A cloud lease with a cancellation clause written in disappearing ink.
node.cap-model-2.name: Model 2: Now With Reasoning
node.cap-model-2.desc: Thinks step by step, then shows you all the steps. All of them.
node.cap-safety-team.name: Safety Team
node.cap-safety-team.desc: Six thoughtful people who write long documents nobody reads until something breaks.
node.cap-gpu-megadeal.name: GPU Megadeal
node.cap-gpu-megadeal.desc: You prepaid for a year of chips. The supplier bought a second yacht to celebrate.
node.cap-model-3.name: Model 3: Multimodal
node.cap-model-3.desc: Sees, hears and talks. Mostly about itself.
node.cap-interpretability.name: Interpretability Lab
node.cap-interpretability.desc: Finds the neuron for "sarcasm". It is also the neuron for "Tuesday".
node.cap-own-chips.name: Custom Silicon
node.cap-own-chips.desc: Your own chip. Faster, cooler, and named after the CEO's dog.
node.cap-model-4.name: Model 4: Agentic
node.cap-model-4.desc: Does tasks on its own. Has opinions about your calendar.
node.cap-alignment.name: Alignment Moonshot
node.cap-alignment.desc: A bold plan to make the model want what you want. First, decide what you want.
node.cap-robotics.name: Robotics Division
node.cap-robotics.desc: The model gets hands. Folds laundry beautifully. Refuses socks.
node.cap-model-5.name: Model 5: Frontier
node.cap-model-5.desc: Smarter than the board. Politely pretends otherwise.
node.reach-app.name: Chat App
node.reach-app.desc: A text box and a send button. Valued at a small country.
node.reach-api.name: Developer API
node.reach-api.desc: Let a million startups build thin wrappers around you.
node.reach-social.name: Social Media Team
node.reach-social.desc: Posts cryptic emoji at 3 a.m. Engagement is through the roof.
node.reach-loc-spanish.name: Localisation: Español
node.reach-loc-spanish.desc: The model learns Spanish, and fourteen ways to say "it depends".
node.reach-enterprise.name: Enterprise Sales
node.reach-enterprise.desc: Same product, a navy-blue logo and a price that starts with "let's talk".
node.reach-media.name: Media Partnerships
node.reach-media.desc: Newspapers license you their archive. You license them their future.
node.reach-loc-asia.name: Localisation: Asia & Africa
node.reach-loc-asia.desc: A hundred languages, each with its own way to decline a refund.
node.reach-partnerships.name: Strategic Partnerships
node.reach-partnerships.desc: Every phone, fridge and car ships with you preinstalled. Some ask first.
node.reach-pr.name: Crisis PR Firm
node.reach-pr.desc: Turns "scandal" into "learning moment" in under four hours.
node.reach-compliance.name: Compliance Office
node.reach-compliance.desc: Two hundred lawyers and a shredder that has never been used. Officially.
node.reach-government.name: Government Contracts
node.reach-government.desc: The ministry runs on you now. Tax season has never been this chatty.
node.reach-superapp.name: The Everything App
node.reach-superapp.desc: Chat, shop, bank, date. Users have stopped opening other apps.
node.shadow-benchmarks.name: Benchmark Tuning
node.shadow-benchmarks.desc: You did not train on the test. The test simply wandered into the data.
node.shadow-lobbying.name: Lobbying Office
node.shadow-lobbying.desc: A tasteful townhouse where lawmakers learn what "frontier" means.
node.shadow-astroturf.name: Grassroots Fans (Paid)
node.shadow-astroturf.desc: Thousands of ordinary citizens love you. They are paid weekly.
node.shadow-poaching.name: Talent Poaching
node.shadow-poaching.desc: Sign-on bonuses so large they come with a private chef. Rivals slow down.
node.shadow-donations.name: Political Donations
node.shadow-donations.desc: You support democracy. Specifically, all of its candidates at once.
node.shadow-demos.name: Staged Demos
node.shadow-demos.desc: Every keynote is live, in the sense that someone is alive behind the curtain.
node.shadow-nda.name: Ironclad NDAs
node.shadow-nda.desc: Former staff may not discuss the company, its products, or the colour blue.
node.shadow-revolving-door.name: Revolving Door
node.shadow-revolving-door.desc: Hire the regulators who wrote the rules. They know where the exits are.
node.shadow-bot-farm.name: Bot Farm
node.shadow-bot-farm.desc: Ten million accounts that all say "game changer". Some of them are even people.
node.shadow-ma-team.name: M&A Team
node.shadow-ma-team.desc: Bankers in vests who can buy a rival lab before lunch. Unlocks acquisitions.
node.shadow-capture.name: Regulatory Capture
node.shadow-capture.desc: The watchdog now reports to you. It still barks, but only at rivals.
node.shadow-hostile.name: Hostile Takeovers
node.shadow-hostile.desc: Buy their investors, then their landlord, then their coffee machine.
founder.researcher.name: The Researcher
founder.researcher.desc: Left academia with a famous paper and no idea what a P&L is. AGI progress +20%.
founder.hustler.name: The Hustler
founder.hustler.desc: Has raised money for nine startups, two of which existed. Users spread 20% faster.
founder.insider.name: The Insider
founder.insider.desc: Used to run the agency that now regulates you. Regulation builds 25% slower.

engine.news.eliminatedBanned: {lab} is shut down by regulators. The servers are being sold by the kilo.
engine.news.eliminatedRevolt: {lab} collapses under public revolt. The logo is now a protest sign.
